title: Test Case (per-section fenced YAML inside a feature library markdown file)
description: Structured metadata for a single test case, parsed from a fenced ```yaml block immediately following a '## TC-XXXX — <title>' heading in a test-plans/content/features/**.md file.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the case definition. Does NOT reflect execution outcome or automation status — those are derived.

automation.description: If 'required', absence of a covering automated test is flagged as a coverage defect on the dashboard.

owner.description: GitHub handle or team alias responsible for this case.

links.description: Structured cross-repo links, grouped by semantic type. Each string MUST be of the form 'org/repo#N'.

crossRepoRef.description: Standard GitHub shorthand for a cross-repo issue or PR, e.g. 'alkem-io/server#4567'.
